_comment: APPROXIMATE overlay sub-areas, hand-digitized from the City of Sausalito Measure J overlay-site map (De Novo Planning Group, 2025) for parcels where the Housing Opportunity Overlay covers only part of the assessor parcel. Each polygon is anchored to the real parcel corners (from measure_j.geojson) and sized to the city's stated acreage, but the boundaries are estimates, not survey data. APNs listed here override the full parcel in measure_j.geojson.

properties.note: Approx. 3-acre overlay portion, rectangular band along the Bridgeway frontage of 1 & 3 Harbor Dr (full parcel is 6.25 ac)
Approx. 1-acre overlay portion (paved/parking area), rectangular band along the Bridgeway frontage of 2680 Bridgeway Blvd (full parcel is 2.26 ac)
Approx. land-based portion (~0.2 ac, buildings west of the shoreline) of 225 Locust / Sausalito Marine; rest of the 2.18-ac parcel is marina water. Clipped to the OSM coastline.
